# algolia_index_config (Resource)

Manages the settings (configuration) of an Algolia index. This resource manages index settings only; it does not create or delete the index itself. Destroying the resource removes it from Terraform state without changing the index unless reset_on_destroy is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_index_config" "products" {
  name = "products"

  searchable_attributes = [
    "name",
    "unordered(description)",
  ]

  attributes_for_faceting = [
    "brand",
    "searchable(categories)",
    "filterOnly(price)",
  ]

  attributes_to_retrieve = ["*"]

  ranking = [
    "typo",
    "geo",
    "words",
    "filters",
    "proximity",
    "attribute",
    "exact",
    "custom",
  ]

  custom_ranking = ["desc(popularity)"]

  max_values_per_facet = 100
  sort_facet_values_by = "count"

  min_word_size_for_1_typo      = 4
  min_word_size_for_2_typos     = 8
  typo_tolerance                = "min"
  allow_typos_on_numeric_tokens = false

  hits_per_page         = 20
  pagination_limited_to = 1000

  attributes_to_highlight = ["name", "description"]
  highlight_pre_tag       = "<mark>"
  highlight_post_tag      = "</mark>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the index whose settings are managed. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `allow_typos_on_numeric_tokens` (Boolean) Whether to allow typos on numbers in the query.
- `attributes_for_faceting` (List of String) Attributes used for faceting and filtering.
- `attributes_to_highlight` (List of String) Attributes to highlight.
- `attributes_to_retrieve` (List of String) Attributes to include in the API response.
- `attributes_to_snippet` (List of String) Attributes to snippet, with an optional number of words.
- `custom_ranking` (List of String) Attributes to use as custom ranking.
- `highlight_post_tag` (String) HTML tag inserted after highlighted parts.
- `highlight_pre_tag` (String) HTML tag inserted before highlighted parts.
- `hits_per_page` (Number) Number of hits per page.
- `max_values_per_facet` (Number) Maximum number of facet values to return for each facet.
- `min_word_size_for_1_typo` (Number) Minimum number of characters a word must contain to accept matches with one typo.
- `min_word_size_for_2_typos` (Number) Minimum number of characters a word must contain to accept matches with two typos.
- `pagination_limited_to` (Number) Maximum number of hits accessible through pagination.
- `ranking` (List of String) Determines the order in which Algolia returns your results.
- `reset_on_destroy` (Boolean) When true, destroying the resource resets the managed settings to Algolia's default values instead of only removing the resource from state. Defaults to false.
- `restrict_highlight_and_snippet_arrays` (Boolean) Whether to restrict highlighting and snippeting to items that matched the query.
- `searchable_attributes` (List of String) Complete list of attributes used for searching.
- `snippet_ellipsis_text` (String) String used as an ellipsis indicator when a snippet is truncated.
- `sort_facet_values_by` (String) Order in which to retrieve facet values: "count" or "alpha".
- `typo_tolerance` (String) Whether typo tolerance is enabled and how it's applied: "true", "false", "min", or "strict".
- `unretrievable_attributes` (List of String) Attributes that can't be retrieved at query time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The index name, used as the resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Index configuration is imported by the index name.
terraform import algolia_index_config.products "products"
```
